formulas.expression: IF( ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Engineering"), TRUE, IF( TEXT(PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c})) <> TEXT({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}), IF( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Engineering") && (NOT(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Status}, "Cancelled")) || NOT(ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Status}, "Closed"))), TRUE, FALSE ), FALSE ) )

formulas.name: IsBizSupportTier1V2
formulas.expression: IF( ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 1"), TRUE, IF( TEXT(PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c})) <> TEXT({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}), IF( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 1") && {!$Record.IsClosed} <> TRUE && {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} <> "Support_T1", TRUE, FALSE ), FALSE ) )

formulas.name: IsTier3ContactCenter
formulas.expression: IF ( ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 3 Contact Center"), TRUE, IF ( ISCHANGED({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}) && TEXT(PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c})) <> TEXT({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}), IF ( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 3 Contact Center") && {!$Record.IsClosed}<> True && OR( {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Support_T1', {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Support_Case', {!$Record.RecordType.DeveloperName} = 'Support_Chat' ), TRUE, FALSE ), FALSE ) )

formulas.name: SupportTier3USV2Criteria
formulas.expression: IF (ISNEW() && ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 3") && (CONTAINS ({!$Record.Account.RC_Service_name__c} , "Office" ) && {!$Record.Account.Total_Account_DL_s__c} >= 20 ) && NOT(OR(CONTAINS({!$Record.Account.RC_Brand__c}, "UK"),CONTAINS({!$Record.Account.RC_Brand__c}, "BT"))) , TRUE, IF( TEXT ( PRIORVALUE({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}) ) <> TEXT ({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}) , IF( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Support_Escalate_To__c}, "Tier 3") && ( NOT( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Status}, "Cancelled") )|| NOT( ISPICKVAL({!$Record.Status}, "Closed") ) ) && ( CONTAINS ({!$Record.Account.RC_Service_name__c} , "Office" ) && {!$Record.Account.Total_Account_DL_s__c} >= 20 ) && NOT(OR(CONTAINS({!$Record.Account.RC_Brand__c}, "UK"),CONTAINS( {!$Record.Account.RC_Brand__c} , "BT"))) , TRUE, FALSE), FALSE))
